faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for project-based research staff positions under project 30-30 Eklavya 2024-26.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Technical Officer, which is a temporary position falling under the research field and requiring advanced qualifications and substantial post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Officer position under this recruitment notification bearing advertisement number OTH/13470/Advt0334.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form online is 05-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they complete and submit their applications before this deadline to avoid rejection.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for IIT Gandhinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the designated recruitment portal of IIT Gandhinagar to fill out and submit their online applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech., B.E., M.Sc., or Professional Qualification or equivalent in an appropriate discipline along with a minimum of 12 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the Technical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Technical Officer post will receive a monthly salary ranging from ₹1,00,000/- to ₹1,65,000/- depending on their qualifications and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Technical Officer position comprises a written test followed by a personal interview to assess the candidate's skills and suitability.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates apply online for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by visiting the official IIT Gandhinagar project staff recruitment website at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/ before the final closing date.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Technical Officer position at IIT Gandhinagar, making the application process straightforward.
